profile.headline: Software Engineer at Objecutive, Inc.
profile.geoLocationName: Sound Beach, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hello, I am currently a Software Engineer working at Objecutive Inc on their premier product FundStudio. There I do primarily backend work, where I have a drive for creating efficient backend infrastructure to handle our clients' positions. 

I have many hobbies, one of them being video games. Speaking of which, I am now the head developer of a game app called NoomiClone which my friend and I codeveloped and has accumulated over 2 million app downloads. 

I love staying active, both physically and mentally, and look forward to a challenge no matter what it is!

positions.locationName: Fort Lee, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created and maintained new horizontally scaling accounting engine in .NET C#which boosted positional computation efficiency by 80%. Used
SQL CLR Assemblies to create RabbitMQ messages on database changes to be load balanced to the accounting engine.
• Created and maintained C# ASP.NET front end pages to give clients and support team access to new accounting data and real time monitoring
of the new engine. Also created and maintained local monitoring and testing Windows Forms applications for the new engine.
• Created and maintained numerous TopShelf windows services in .NET C# which hosted parts of the accounting engine, such as the computa‑
tional server and NLog logging server.
• Worked in an agile environment, implementing client requests into the engine with minimal downtime. Carefully crafted implementation plan
to gradually switch the accounting engine on for production databases, to ensure data correctness and stress test the engine. This involved
modifying existing VB.NET code from the legacy accounting engine when needed.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Created and refactored T‑SQL stored procedures that tied together Fund Studio’s legacy accounting engine with the new accounting engine.
• Implemented foreign exchange rate calculations in .NET C# for the new accounting engine.
• Aided colleagues during migration from Team Foundation Server into Git using Bitbucket.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: Creator of NoomiClone, a Unity Mobile game on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Programmed in C#, and all facets of Game Development, Art, and Management handled by me. 3,000,000+ downloads with 100,000+ Average Monthly Active Users.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · C# · Advertising · Video Game Production · Game Design

positions.title: Code Coach
positions.description:
• Taught beginner to advanced programming concepts in M.I.T.’s Scratch, Python, and Java.
• Broke down basic concepts of programming into understandable terms to teach kids as young as 4 years old, while also employing similar
tactics to teach Object Oriented Programming to people 13+.
• Used Zoom and other online communication tools to teach, discuss with other coaches, and provide detailed lesson plans and notes.
• Personally tutored around 10 clients per work week. Also hosted project creation orientated camps of 10 kids during the Summer and Winter.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Java

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Taught Data Structures (CSE 214) recitations, both in person and on Zoom, to a group of 30 students on a weekly basis.
• Hosted biweekly office hours, working one‑on‑one to help students with both conceptual questions and programming help.
• Created teaching, and study materials to reinforce concepts taught in lecture that week. Hosted several review sessions to 100+ students to
review for major tests. Graded quizes and homeworks.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Structures · Java

positions.description:

•Strictly comply with both HIPAA and privacy regulations pertaining to patient information

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Worked and currently Volunteering at local gymnastics center, supervising and teaching groups of 25+ (all different ages and ability levels),
movement skills, while promoting safety and physical fitness.
• Teaching complex skills by breaking them down into logical and easier to understand progressions to increase safety, and speed of learning.
• Self practice of different movement disciplines for fun, and physical fitness.

projects.title: NoomiClone
projects.description:
• Primary Developer of C# Unity physics-based flipping game. Close to 2,000,000 downloads on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store
combined. Ran Social media accounts and hosted online communities to discuss the game and receive feedback and bug reports

projects.title: Redistricting Web App
projects.description:
• Designed and implemented web app as a team of four classmates. The web app allowed users to sort and filter through close to 1,000,000
United States congressional districtings for the states of Georgia, Michigan, and North Carolina. All data collection and pre‑processing was
done by the team, using data from the 2016 election.
• The tech stack consisted of a Reactfrontend that used a MapBox map for dispalying GeoJSON files and Material‑UI for a sleek and intuitive user
interface. Spring Boot Java to act as a RESTful backend server connected to a MySQL server. A RESTful Flask Python server for GeoJSON
Geometry calculations. Python was also used for all our data preprocessing and creating of districtings using Slurm jobs on Stony Brook’s
supercomputer.
• Acted as a project manager, organizing the groups efforts and general project direction and documentation. Wrote a majority of the FrontEnd,
but also helped out in all other project areas. The project was scored as the top project in our class
